ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud cases, including the sources of funding and the recipients of fraudulent payments
questions: Who is behind the Medicaid fraud schemes?
How are they getting away with it?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover the root causes of Medicaid fraud and identify the key players involved. This could lead to a larger investigation and potentially even more significant recoveries.
